title: Find K Closest Elements
summary: Select k entries from sorted arr that are closest to x.

contractDetails.output-checking: Exact typed equality of the returned ints.

statement: Select k entries from sorted arr that are closest to x. A smaller distance wins. Equal distances prefer the smaller value. Return the selected values in nondecreasing order, keeping selected duplicate occurrences.

examples.explanation: The two nearest entries are 3 and 5.
Both copies of the closest value are selected.

hints: Conceptual: The selected positions form a contiguous interval of the sorted array.
Directional: Discard the more distant endpoint until exactly k positions remain.
Implementation: When endpoint distances tie, remove the right endpoint so the smaller value survives.
complexityAnalysis: O(n) time and O(k) output space, with O(1) auxiliary state.
